verses.original: דְּבַר־ יְהוָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָיָ֔ה אֶל־ יוֹאֵ֖ל בֶּן־ פְּתוּאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: də·ḇar- Yah·weh ’ă·šer hā·yāh ’el- yō·w·’êl ben- pə·ṯū·’êl
verses.literal: [This is] the word of the LORD that came to Joel son of Pethuel

verses.original: שִׁמְעוּ־ זֹאת֙ הַזְּקֵנִ֔ים וְהַֽאֲזִ֔ינוּ כֹּ֖ל יוֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָאָ֑רֶץ זֹּאת֙ הֶהָ֤יְתָה בִּֽימֵיכֶ֔ם וְאִ֖ם בִּימֵ֥י אֲבֹֽתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: šim·‘ū- zōṯ haz·zə·qê·nîm wə·ha·’ă·zî·nū kōl yō·wō·šə·ḇê hā·’ā·reṣ zōṯ he·hā·yə·ṯāh bî·mê·ḵem wə·’im bî·mê ’ă·ḇō·ṯê·ḵem
verses.literal: Hear this O elders and give ear all who dwell in the land Has anything like this ever happened in your days or in the days of your fathers

verses.original: סַפֵּ֑רוּ עָלֶ֖יהָ לִבְנֵיכֶ֣ם וּבְנֵיכֶם֙ לִבְנֵיהֶ֔ם וּבְנֵיהֶ֖ם אַחֵֽר׃ לְד֥וֹר
verses.transliteration: sap·pê·rū ‘ā·le·hā liḇ·nê·ḵem ū·ḇə·nê·ḵem liḇ·nê·hem ū·ḇə·nê·hem ’a·ḥêr lə·ḏō·wr
verses.literal: Tell it to your children let your children tell it to their children and their children to the next generation

verses.original: הַגָּזָם֙ יֶ֤תֶר הָֽאַרְבֶּ֔ה אָכַ֣ל הָאַרְבֶּ֖ה וְיֶ֥תֶר הַיָּ֑לֶק אָכַ֣ל הַיֶּ֔לֶק וְיֶ֣תֶר הֶחָסִֽיל׃ אָכַ֖ל
verses.transliteration: hag·gā·zām ye·ṯer hā·’ar·beh ’ā·ḵal hā·’ar·beh wə·ye·ṯer hay·yā·leq ’ā·ḵal hay·ye·leq wə·ye·ṯer he·ḥā·sîl ’ā·ḵal
verses.literal: What the devouring locust has left the swarming locust has eaten what the swarming locust has left the young locust has eaten and what the young locust has left the destroying locust has eaten

verses.original: הָקִ֤יצוּ שִׁכּוֹרִים֙ וּבְכ֔וּ וְהֵילִ֖לוּ כָּל־ שֹׁ֣תֵי יָ֑יִן עַל־ עָסִ֕יס כִּ֥י נִכְרַ֖ת מִפִּיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hā·qî·ṣū šik·kō·w·rîm ū·ḇə·ḵū wə·hê·li·lū kāl- šō·ṯê yā·yin ‘al- ‘ā·sîs kî niḵ·raṯ mip·pî·ḵem
verses.literal: Wake up you drunkards and weep wail all you drinkers of wine because of the sweet wine for it has been cut off from your mouth

verses.original: כִּֽי־ גוֹי֙ עָלָ֣ה עַל־ אַרְצִ֔י עָצ֖וּם וְאֵ֣ין מִסְפָּ֑ר שִׁנָּיו֙ שִׁנֵּ֣י אַרְיֵ֔ה וּֽמְתַלְּע֥וֹת לָבִ֖יא לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḡō·w ‘ā·lāh ‘al- ’ar·ṣî ‘ā·ṣūm wə·’ên mis·pār šin·nāw šin·nê ’ar·yêh ū·mə·ṯal·lə·‘ō·wṯ lā·ḇî lōw
verses.literal: For a nation has invaded . . . My land powerful and without number its teeth [are] the teeth of a lion and its fangs [are the fangs] of a lioness

verses.original: שָׂ֤ם לְשַׁמָּ֔ה גַּפְנִי֙ לִקְצָפָ֑ה וּתְאֵנָתִ֖י חָשֹׂ֤ף חֲשָׂפָהּ֙ וְהִשְׁלִ֔יךְ שָׂרִיגֶֽיהָ׃ הִלְבִּ֖ינוּ
verses.transliteration: śām lə·šam·māh gap̄·nî liq·ṣā·p̄āh ū·ṯə·’ê·nā·ṯî ḥā·śōp̄ ḥă·śā·p̄āh wə·hiš·lîḵ śā·rî·ḡe·hā hil·bî·nū
verses.literal: It has laid waste My grapevine and splintered My fig tree It has stripped off the bark . . . and thrown it away the branches have turned white

verses.original: אֱלִ֕י כִּבְתוּלָ֥ה חֲגֻֽרַת־ שַׂ֖ק עַל־ בַּ֥עַל נְעוּרֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·lî kiḇ·ṯū·lāh ḥă·ḡu·raṯ- śaq ‘al- ba·‘al nə·‘ū·re·hā
verses.literal: Wail like a virgin dressed in sackcloth grieving for the husband of her youth

verses.original: מִנְחָ֛ה וָנֶ֖סֶךְ הָכְרַ֥ת מִבֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים אָֽבְלוּ֙ מְשָׁרְתֵ֖י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: min·ḥāh wā·ne·seḵ hā·ḵə·raṯ mib·bêṯ Yah·weh hak·kō·hă·nîm ’ā·ḇə·lū mə·šā·rə·ṯê Yah·weh
verses.literal: Grain and drink offerings . . . have been cut off from the house of the LORD the priests are in mourning those who minister before the LORD

verses.original: שָׂדֶ֔ה שֻׁדַּ֣ד אֲדָמָ֑ה אָבְלָ֖ה כִּ֚י דָּגָ֔ן שֻׁדַּ֣ד תִּיר֖וֹשׁ אֻמְלַ֥ל הוֹבִ֥ישׁ יִצְהָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: śā·ḏeh šud·daḏ ’ă·ḏā·māh ’ā·ḇə·lāh kî dā·ḡān šud·daḏ tî·rō·wōš ’um·lal hō·w·ḇîš yiṣ·hār
verses.literal: The field is ruined the land mourns For the grain is destroyed the new wine . . . is dried up [and] the oil fails

verses.original: הֹבִ֣ישׁוּ אִכָּרִ֗ים הֵילִ֙ילוּ֙ כֹּֽרְמִ֔ים עַל־ חִטָּ֖ה וְעַל־ שְׂעֹרָ֑ה כִּ֥י קְצִ֥יר שָׂדֶֽה׃ אָבַ֖ד
verses.transliteration: hō·ḇî·šū ’ik·kā·rîm hê·lî·lū kō·rə·mîm ‘al- ḥiṭ·ṭāh wə·‘al- śə·‘ō·rāh kî qə·ṣîr śā·ḏeh ’ā·ḇaḏ
verses.literal: Be dismayed O farmers wail O vinedressers over the wheat and barley because the harvest of the field has perished

verses.original: הַגֶּ֣פֶן הוֹבִ֔ישָׁה וְהַתְּאֵנָ֖ה אֻמְלָ֑לָה רִמּ֞וֹן גַּם־ תָּמָ֣ר וְתַפּ֗וּחַ כָּל־ עֲצֵ֤י הַשָּׂדֶה֙ יָבֵ֔שׁוּ כִּֽי־ שָׂשׂ֖וֹן מִן־ בְּנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃ס הֹבִ֥ישׁ
verses.transliteration: hag·ge·p̄en hō·w·ḇî·šāh wə·hat·tə·’ê·nāh ’um·lā·lāh rim·mō·wn gam- tā·mār wə·ṯap·pū·aḥ kāl- ‘ă·ṣê haś·śā·ḏeh yā·ḇê·šū kî- śā·śō·wn min- bə·nê ’ā·ḏām hō·ḇîš
verses.literal: The grapevine is dried up and the fig tree is withered the pomegranate . . . palm and apple all the trees of the orchard are withered Surely the joy of vvv mankind has dried up

verses.original: חִגְר֨וּ וְסִפְד֜וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֗ים הֵילִ֙ילוּ֙ מְשָׁרְתֵ֣י מִזְבֵּ֔חַ בֹּ֚אוּ לִ֣ינוּ בַשַּׂקִּ֔ים מְשָׁרְתֵ֖י אֱלֹהָ֑י כִּ֥י מִנְחָ֥ה וָנָֽסֶךְ׃ נִמְנַ֛ע מִבֵּ֥ית אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם
verses.transliteration: ḥiḡ·rū wə·sip̄·ḏū hak·kō·hă·nîm hê·lî·lū mə·šā·rə·ṯê miz·bê·aḥ bō·’ū lî·nū ḇaś·śaq·qîm mə·šā·rə·ṯê ’ĕ·lō·hāy kî min·ḥāh wā·nā·seḵ nim·na‘ mib·bêṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem
verses.literal: Put on [sackcloth] and lament O priests wail O ministers of the altar Come spend the night in sackcloth O ministers of my God because the grain and drink offerings are withheld from the house of your God

verses.original: קַדְּשׁוּ־ צוֹם֙ קִרְא֣וּ עֲצָרָ֔ה אִסְפ֣וּ זְקֵנִ֗ים כֹּ֚ל יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ בֵּ֖ית יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֑ם וְזַעֲק֖וּ אֶל־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: qad·də·šū- ṣō·wm qir·’ū ‘ă·ṣā·rāh ’is·p̄ū zə·qê·nîm kōl yō·šə·ḇê hā·’ā·reṣ bêṯ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem wə·za·‘ă·qū ’el- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Consecrate a fast proclaim a solemn assembly Gather the elders and all the residents of the land to the house of the LORD your God and cry out to the LORD

verses.original: אֲהָ֖הּ לַיּ֑וֹם כִּ֤י י֣וֹם יְהוָ֔ה קָרוֹב֙ יָבֽוֹא׃ וּכְשֹׁ֖ד מִשַׁדַּ֥י
verses.transliteration: ’ă·hāh lay·yō·wm kî yō·wm Yah·weh qā·rō·wḇ yā·ḇō·w ū·ḵə·šōḏ mi·šad·day
verses.literal: Alas for the day For the Day of the LORD is near and it will come as destruction from the Almighty

verses.original: הֲל֛וֹא אֹ֣כֶל נִכְרָ֑ת נֶ֥גֶד עֵינֵ֖ינוּ שִׂמְחָ֥ה וָגִֽיל׃ מִבֵּ֥ית אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ
verses.transliteration: hă·lō·w ’ō·ḵel niḵ·rāṯ ne·ḡeḏ ‘ê·nê·nū śim·ḥāh wā·ḡîl mib·bêṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū
verses.literal: Has not the food been cut off before our very eyes joy and gladness from the house of our God

verses.original: פְרֻד֗וֹת עָבְשׁ֣וּ תַּ֚חַת מֶגְרְפֹ֣תֵיהֶ֔ם אֹֽצָר֔וֹת נָשַׁ֙מּוּ֙ מַמְּגֻר֑וֹת נֶהֶרְס֖וּ כִּ֥י דָּגָֽן׃ הֹבִ֖ישׁ
verses.transliteration: p̄ə·ru·ḏō·wṯ ‘ā·ḇə·šū ta·ḥaṯ meḡ·rə·p̄ō·ṯê·hem ’ō·ṣā·rō·wṯ nā·šam·mū mam·mə·ḡu·rō·wṯ ne·her·sū kî dā·ḡān hō·ḇîš
verses.literal: The seeds lie shriveled beneath the clods the storehouses are in ruins the granaries are broken down for the grain has withered away

verses.original: מַה־ בְהֵמָ֗ה נֶּאֶנְחָ֣ה עֶדְרֵ֣י בָקָ֔ר נָבֹ֙כוּ֙ כִּ֛י אֵ֥ין מִרְעֶ֖ה לָהֶ֑ם גַּם־ עֶדְרֵ֥י הַצֹּ֖אן נֶאְשָֽׁמוּ׃
verses.transliteration: mah- ḇə·hê·māh ne·’en·ḥāh ‘eḏ·rê ḇā·qār nā·ḇō·ḵū kî ’ên mir·‘eh lā·hem gam- ‘eḏ·rê haṣ·ṣōn ne’·šā·mū
verses.literal: How the cattle groan The herds . . . wander in confusion because they have no pasture . . . Even the flocks of sheep are suffering

verses.original: אֵלֶ֥יךָ יְהוָ֖ה אֶקְרָ֑א כִּ֣י אֵ֗שׁ אָֽכְלָה֙ מִדְבָּ֔ר נְא֣וֹת וְלֶ֣הָבָ֔ה לִהֲטָ֖ה כָּל־ עֲצֵ֥י הַשָּׂדֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ê·le·ḵā Yah·weh ’eq·rā kî ’êš ’ā·ḵə·lāh miḏ·bār nə·’ō·wṯ wə·le·hā·ḇāh li·hă·ṭāh kāl- ‘ă·ṣê haś·śā·ḏeh
verses.literal: To You O LORD I call for fire has consumed the open pastures and flames have scorched all the trees of the field

verses.original: גַּם־ בַּהֲמ֥וֹת שָׂדֶ֖ה תַּעֲר֣וֹג אֵלֶ֑יךָ כִּ֤י אֲפִ֣יקֵי מָ֔יִם יָֽבְשׁוּ֙ וְאֵ֕שׁ אָכְלָ֖ה הַמִּדְבָּֽר׃פ נְא֥וֹת
verses.transliteration: gam- ba·hă·mō·wṯ śā·ḏeh ta·‘ă·rō·wḡ ’ê·le·ḵā kî ’ă·p̄î·qê mā·yim yā·ḇə·šū wə·’êš ’ā·ḵə·lāh ham·miḏ·bār nə·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: Even the beasts of the field pant for You for the streams of water have dried up and fire has consumed the open pastures
